definition: A milestone closes an observable workflow across its dependent passes; no fixed number of passes automatically earns one.

milestones.name: Concern foundation
milestones.workflow: Organize one concern, retain stable identities, read original evidence, save separate notes and keep shared jobs independent of desktop closure.

milestones.name: Shared reading
milestones.workflow: The owner reviews and publishes an exact view; a paired satellite reads the same identity/revision through an inert renderer with its own presentation.

milestones.name: Documents and working knowledge
milestones.workflow: Optional notes exchange, source-bound notebook blocks, engineering tables/BOMs and the declared editable-document profile work together with visible conversion losses.

milestones.name: Traceable engineering desk
milestones.workflow: Navigate exact source, manage real tasks, trace claims/dependencies and compare hypothetical candidates without rewriting accepted history.

milestones.name: Grounded Slate reasoning
milestones.workflow: staC (pronounced Stacy), reproducible recipes, actual local-model reasoning and genuine reviewed Frontier/Gemini exchanges share checked source and effect contracts.

milestones.name: Durable continuity
milestones.workflow: Evaluated study, exact-context resume, real model replacement, complete verified recovery and device reconnect preserve decisions and avoid duplicate work.

milestones.name: Hosted conversational office
milestones.workflow: Guided Debian hosting, a conversation-first satellite, optional collaboration/mail adapters and actual voice use one concern and service.

milestones.name: Owner-qualified release
milestones.workflow: Resolve the conditional graphical bridge pilot, prove the real iPhone/home network and ThinkPad workflow, then rehearse installation/update/restore with independent acceptance.

qualification: Development demonstration and actual owner/independent acceptance are separate states. Every milestone retains owner/independent acceptance OPEN until its own evidence exists.
count_basis: Eight capability groups, not equal effort or percentages. Dependencies overlap (P17 serves M1 and M2); count each retained delivery once. N2/G1-G5 is one expanded delivery. Historical 86/225 points are unchanged.
standing_handoff: Include a roughly ten-minute discussion of current state, next work, milestone movement and final destination with every pass.
